ns2:section.sectionText: Chinese Cinema This course introduces, analyzes, and critiques contemporary Chinese cinema. We view films, read academic writings on Chinese cinema, and discuss these questions: What are the trends of contemporary Chinese cinema? To what extent is Chinese cinema transnational? What does øtransnationalø denote? How is contemporary Chinese cinema related to other East Asian cinemas and to Hollywood? How do we understand the social transformations of contemporary China reflected in Chinese cinema? What are the visual and cinematic innovations of Chinese cinema? Knowledge of Chinese language and culture not required.
